# Pac-Man Arcade (Android Edition)

**Developer: Md. Abu Rise Zunaed**

---

## Option 1: Native Android Project (`Pac-Man-Android.zip`)

Download **`Pac-Man-Android.zip`** from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/mdaburisezunaed/Pac_man/releases) or the `dist/` folder:
- **Immersive Fullscreen:** Uses `SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY` with full hardware acceleration.
- **Pre-packaged Assets:** Includes all game logic, retro sounds, custom icons (`mdpi`, `hdpi`, `xhdpi`, `xxhdpi`, `xxxhdpi`), and responsive layout.
- **Open in Android Studio:** Open the extracted directory in Android Studio and hit **Run** or build the signed APK (`Build > Build Bundle(s) / APK(s) > Build APK(s)`).

---

## Option 2: Zero-Build Instant Play (WebAPK / PWA)

Android users can install and play Pac-Man without any coding, compiler, or build tools via WebAPK / PWA installation:

### Step 1: Open in Google Chrome
1. Open **Google Chrome** on your Android smartphone or tablet.
2. Open the Pac-Man web game (`web/index.html` hosted on your local network or server).

### Step 2: Install as Native Android App
1. Tap the **three dots menu (⋮)** in the top right of Chrome.
2. Tap **"Install app"** (or **"Add to Home screen"**).
3. Confirm **Install**.

### Step 3: Launch & Play
- A dedicated **Pac-Man** app icon with the custom logo will appear in your Android app drawer and home screen.
- The game opens in full screen (no browser URL bar or navigation buttons).
- Full touch controls: on-screen retro arcade D-pad, action buttons, and swipe gestures.

---

## Controls
- **Virtual D-Pad:** Tap the directional arrows (▲, ▼, ◀, ▶)
- **Swipe Gestures:** Swipe anywhere on the screen in the direction you want Pac-Man to turn
- **Start / Action:** Tap the **START / ENTER** button
- **Pause & Mute:** On-screen quick toggles
